title: Balkh, the year one thousand and thirty two… | Folio 1 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Balkh, the year one thousand and thirty two. A gallows stands outside the city. The man they bring to it was, not long ago, the most powerful minister in the empire. And when it was over, he was left alone, just as alone as he had come from his mother's womb.

The full story: Folio 1: The Vizier on the Gallows — on our channel and on every podcast app.
